statement: The system shall provide a teleoperated manipulator with a well-articulated boom and multiple joints to facilitate movement within a vessel.
The system shall incorporate a camera system with multiple cameras, including a front-facing camera and a camera arm, to provide a 3D view on 2D screens.
The system shall have a user interface that allows operators to control the manipulator using pre-programmed moves and teach files.
The system shall provide a feature to restrict movement to specific areas, such as a 'no-go zone' or a pre-programmed wall, to prevent accidents.
The system shall provide force feedback or a buzzer to alert the operator when they are over-gripping an object.
The system shall provide a frame rate that is high enough to ensure smooth and accurate movement of the manipulator.
The system shall provide a feature to adjust the force ratios on the arms to accommodate heavy objects and reduce strain on the operator's hands.
The system shall provide a simulation environment, such as a VR simulator, to allow operators to practice and train before working with the actual system.
The system shall provide a way to validate the design and functionality of the system, such as through testing and modeling.
The system shall be designed to minimize delay and latency, with a goal of zero delay, to ensure accurate and safe operation.
